title: Longitudinal Panel, Outcome Claim And Comparison Control Registry
scope: Thirty-two empty longitudinal panel shells, eight not-ready outcome-claim dockets, and eight comparison embargo registers for the Phase 70 admission layer.
interpretation_boundary: A panel shell is not a series. An admitted series is not automatically a trend or outcome. A bounded outcome claim is not causation. No cross-entity comparison, score, composite, or ranking is permitted without a separately approved common contract.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Admitted series basis
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Every supporting panel resolves to an explicitly admitted compatible series.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Stable identity and scope
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: The claim preserves one named entity, operating scope, receiving authority, and lifecycle stage.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Repeated-period sufficiency
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Period coverage, cadence, missingness, partial periods, and any minimum sufficiency decision are explicit.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Direction and magnitude
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Any direction, magnitude, or rate is calculated only from admitted points under the declared measure contract.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Denominator and method compatibility
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Units, denominators, exposure, methods, versions, and revisions remain compatible or visibly segmented.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Breaks, revisions, and adverse evidence
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Missing periods, failures, outages, exceptions, corrections, and adverse observations remain visible.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Alternative explanations and counterfactuals
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Plausible alternative explanations and the limits of any counterfactual are stated before attribution.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Attribution and receiving authority
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: The responsible actor, receiving authority, intervention boundary, and non-transfer rule are explicit.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Uncertainty, sensitivity, and limitations
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Coverage, uncertainty, sensitivity to definitions, and interpretation limits accompany the claim.

outcome_inference_dimensions.label: Dual-control claim decision and propagation
outcome_inference_dimensions.question: Two authorized reviewers issue a bounded claim decision and complete every assigned reader-surface update.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Common entity class and question
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Compared entities answer one explicitly common operating-outcome question.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Common measure and unit
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: The numerator definition and source-declared units are compatible.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Common denominator or exposure
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: The denominator, population, capacity, exposure, or not-applicable basis is compatible.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Compatible periods and cadence
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Coverage windows, cadence, partial periods, and missingness are compatible.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Compatible method and version
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Collection, calculation, test, threshold, and method versions are compatible.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Common lifecycle and acceptance stage
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: The compared records occupy a common operating and receiving-system stage.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Visible breaks, missingness, and revisions
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Every break, exclusion, correction, restatement, and missing period remains visible.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Comparable uncertainty and coverage
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Coverage and uncertainty permit the bounded comparison being proposed.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: No composite or ranking inference
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: A bounded comparison cannot silently become a score, league table, composite, or rank.

comparison_eligibility_dimensions.label: Human comparison decision and propagation
comparison_eligibility_dimensions.question: Two authorized reviewers approve the exact comparison and propagate its receipt and limitations.
